give the boat a half turn so it faces back the way it came
now give the doorway the same red neon glow and keep the sign above it exactly as it is, so the two do not compete for attention
now give the boat the same white outline and keep the line the same weight, because the two sit side by side on the water
give the wall a solid grey fill and put a thin white outline round the window
now put a white windmill there too beside the same wide lake, and leave the reeds and the nest along the shore untouched.
maybe a little bush could go by the side of the house, and keep the gate and the driveway open.
a house right beside the barn, for now.

draw a wooden wagon not too far from the well, so the shadow does not reach the door.
do the same with a tall tree just by the same house, just outside arm's reach of the wall.
a wagon a few steps from the house, for now.
what if we put a little duck in the river, well out from the edge, not on the bank.
put a small boat in the lake, well out from the edge, not on the bank, and turn it slightly to the left.
could you put a tall tree on the surface of the hill, so its base sits into the slope rather than on top of it.
what if we put a yellow bus on the dirt road, so it does not block the gate to the field.
what if we put an old windmill next to the narrow road, well off the road and back from the gate.
I would like an old fence by the side of the road, well off the road, where the grass is wide.
put a white house down the side of the dirt road, so the whole side of the road looks tidy.
let there be an old well between the left tree and the right tree, so the gap on the left macthes the gap on the right.
I want a low fence at the back of the old house, so the light from the back window still reaches the lawn.
add a round rock at the front of the white house, so the shadow does not fall across the entrance.
there should be a small well directly in front of the old house, so it is the first thing seen from the road, and make it red.
is there room for a grey pot atop the table, so it can be seen from the path?
add a white cloud high above the house, with the chimney smoke drifting below, and keep it the same size.
put a small bird below the grey cloud, with the sky open below it, and make it red.
we could use a blue balloon right below the big cloud, so it can be sen from the field below.
add a grey cat beneath the tree, and leave the trunk and the low branches clear, and keep it the same size.
add a brown dog on the inside of the white fence, and leave the flower bed and the path alone, and make it red.
add a small rock beyond the fence, and leave the gate and the field track clear, and turn it slightly to the left.
let there be a little raft on the river, so the bridge stays in sight from the bank.
put a small boat on the lake, without covering the bridge from the shore, and keep it the same size.
